q: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting committee of the Constitution of India?
explanation: Dr B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee (set up 29 August 1947). Prasad presided over the Assembly, B.N. Rau was the adviser and Munshi/Alladi were members.

notes.text: - **Chairman: Dr B.R. Ambedkar** – the **"architect" / "Father" of the Constitution**, "Modern Manu".

q: Who was the architect of the Indian Constitution?
explanation: Dr B.R. Ambedkar, chairman of the Drafting Committee, is called the architect (chief architect, father) of the Indian Constitution.

notes.text: - **Chairman: Dr B.R. Ambedkar** – the **"architect" / "Father" of the Constitution**, "Modern Manu".

q: The first President of the Constituent Assembly of India was
explanation: The first person to preside, as temporary President, was Dr Sachchidananda Sinha (9 December 1946); Rajendra Prasad was the first elected permanent President from 11 December 1946.

notes.text: - **"First President" of the Assembly:** the first to preside was **Sachchidananda Sinha** (temporary); the elected (permanent) President was **Rajendra Prasad** – read which one the question wants.

q: Of the following, who was the Member of the Drafting Committee of the Constitution of India?
explanation: K.M. Munshi, N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar and Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar were all members of the Drafting Committee.

notes.text: - Members: **N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar**, **Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar**, **K.M. Munshi**, **Mohammad Saadullah**, **B.L. Mitter** (replaced by **N. Madhava Rau**), **D.P. Khaitan** (died 1948; replaced by **T.T. Krishnamachari**).

q: Who was the legal advisor to the Constituent Assembly?
explanation: The legal (Constitutional) Adviser was B.N. Rau; Sachchidananda Sinha was the temporary President and Alladi a Drafting Committee member.

notes.text: - **Sir B.N. (Benegal Narsing) Rau** – **Constitutional / legal Adviser**; prepared the **first draft** in **October 1947**: **243 Articles, 13 Schedules**, placed before the Drafting Committee.

q: Which one of the following was a member of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India?
explanation: K.M. Munshi was a member of the Drafting Committee; Kripalani, Vijayalakshmi Pandit and Rajendra Prasad were not.

notes.text: - Members: **N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar**, **Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar**, **K.M. Munshi**, **Mohammad Saadullah**, **B.L. Mitter** (replaced by **N. Madhava Rau**), **D.P. Khaitan** (died 1948; replaced by **T.T. Krishnamachari**).
- **NOT members:** **Nehru**, **Rajendra Prasad**, **J.B. Kripalani**, **Sardar Patel**, **Vijayalakshmi Pandit**, B.N. Rau (adviser, not member).

q: Who was the president of the constituent Assembly?
explanation: Dr Rajendra Prasad was elected permanent President (Chairman) of the Constituent Assembly on 11 December 1946. Ambedkar chaired only the Drafting Committee; Sinha was the temporary President.
